full_judgment:
2. This petition by defendant No.1 Md Yakub Ali is for leave to appeal from the judgment and order dated 23 March 1998 of the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division who discharged the Rule in Civil Revision No.3021 of 1996 preferred against the judgment and decree dated 30 July 1996 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Mithapukur in Other Suit No.119 of 1995 under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act. 

 5. The trial Court on consideration of the evidence on record found the claim of the plaintiff true and decreed the suit. 

 8. It is argued before us that the disputed property was an email property of the parties and so without a partition of the land amongst them, the plaintiff could not maintain specific possession in respect of the disputed land and so the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division fell into an error of law in upholding the decree passed by the trial Court. 

 9. All that a plaintiff in a suit under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act is required to prove is his possession and dispossession within 6(six) months next before the institution of the suit. The trial Court factually found the possession and dispossession of the plaintiff from the disputed land within the specified period. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division found no error of law in the said finding. In a suit of this nature the court is quite competent to pass a decree in favour of the plaintiff for recovery of possession of the suit land, notwithstanding any claim of title that may be set up in defence. We, therefore, find no merit in the contention.
